meaning: An online audio show made in episodes for a phone or computer.
clues: It is a way to get programs through the internet.
It is usually made of spoken episodes that you can hear when you choose.
A show may add a new episode on a set schedule, like a radio series you can save.
It can be an interview with guests, a story told by a host, or a talk about one topic.
Its name starts with P and has seven letters.
assumes: An audiobook is a book read aloud.
An internet radio station sends a continuing radio program.
A live video is a moving picture sent while an event happens.

decoys.meaning: A recorded reading of a book that you listen to on a device.
A radio service that sends audio shows through the internet.
A video that is sent over the internet while it is happening.
